Your Driver License Restrictions and Renewals","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## C — Your Driver License Restrictions and Renewals

FACT_ID: sec02-F01 | anchor: A01
Your license stays state property that Oklahoma can deny, cancel, suspend, or revoke for lawbreaking, and the driving privilege it grants, earned through tests and fees, must be carried whenever you drive [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-F02 | anchor: A01
Lost, destroyed, or unreadable cards are replaced through a licensed operator, a local examiner, or online application, but only a still-valid Oklahoma license qualifies for replacement [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-F03 | anchor: A01
Licenses issue for four or eight years counted from your fee month, expire on that last day of the month, and may renew up to one full year early [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-F04 | anchor: A01
Non-citizens handle originals, renewals, and replacements only with a Service Oklahoma examiner, show every immigration paper each visit, and carry expirations matching those papers, except legal permanent residents who renew or replace anywhere with a valid resident card [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-F05 | anchor: A01
Renewals run online, military members posted outside Oklahoma gain sixty days after returning home with mail renewal optional, and cards expired over a year force an in-person visit with a certified birth certificate or passport [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-F06 | anchor: A01
Movers must tell Service Oklahoma within ten days through a licensed operator, online, or by mail to its Oklahoma City post office box eleven-four-fifteen, name changers must show a certified marriage or court paper, and stale addresses risk losing the license or even suspension without mailed notice [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-F07 | anchor: A01
Every license stays probationary until eighteen, a trial span where Service Oklahoma may cancel or suspend for any unlawful act, negligence, or misconduct behind the wheel [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-F08 | anchor: A01
Driving without a license or permit breaks the law even beside a licensed driver, with both driver and the person who allowed it subject to arrest, just as parents violate by letting unlicensed children drive and owners violate by lending to unlicensed drivers [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-F09 | anchor: A02
Restrictions are safety conditions coded on the license with letter A marking qualified vehicle types like motorcycles or hazmat trucks, and conviction for driving unlicensed or violating a restriction brings up to five hundred dollars, six months in jail, or both [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-F10 | anchor: A02
Code B means corrective lenses, F a left outside mirror for weak left vision or hearing, two either B or F, four an automatic transmission for physical need, five turn indicators plus power steering or a knob for limited hands, six food in reach for insulin diabetes, seven adequate artificial limbs, and eight further detailed conditions [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-F11 | anchor: A02
Code nine seats a twenty-one-plus licensed companion up front for learners, while code zero limits under-sixteen riders to three-hundred-cubic-centimeter machines from half past four in the morning to nine at night with no passengers, caps sub-one-hundred-fifty machines at thirty-five miles per hour off minimum-speed highways, lifts at sixteen, and still helmets everyone under eighteen [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec02-F12 | anchor: A02
Restriction A marks motorcycle learners under watchful twenty-one-plus endorsed supervision, T marks graduated drivers holding five-morning-to-ten-night hours except for school, church, work, or a twenty-one-plus companion with one or household-only passengers and no T past eighteen, obsolete or wrong restrictions clear through an examiner, and new endorsements need an examiner visit plus passed tests [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0014]
